description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 05.06.2017 to 11.06.2017
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine how customs calculations will be made. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework implementation for customs operations, specifically modifying how the Customs Ordinance is applied through statutory instruments.
